title: A simulation-first workflow turns LLM research into interactive learning
friendlyTitle: Build a small simulation to learn a hard topic
summary: Engineer Laurentiu Raducu describes using coding agents to research a complex topic, review the resulting knowledge base and build a small interactive simulation rather than stopping at a written explanation. His examples visualize chip fabrication, rocket engines, language models and other systems as explorable web projects.
friendlySummary: Instead of asking AI for a simple explanation, this workflow asks it to research a topic and build an interactive picture of how the process works.
whyItMatters: Building a model of a process can expose gaps that passive reading hides and create a reusable learning aid. The claim that a generated simulation is fully accurate is too strong, so learners should verify key facts against authoritative sources and ask domain experts to review important details.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Making and exploring a model can help ideas stay in your memory. Always check important facts because a polished simulation can still contain mistakes.
